Needs your attention

Changed 4 Nov

Return flight now leaves at 19:55, not 20:00

China Eastern retimed it on 4 Nov. The notice lists only FM867 now, where the ticket said MU8621 / FM867. Arrival in Kota Kinabalu is unchanged at 00:30. Open the booking before you check in and make sure the ticket still shows.

Replied 6 Nov

Hotel confirmed: staffed around the clock, room held all night

The hotel answered your message through Trip.com on 6 Nov (Trip.com's notice is stamped 11:06 Malaysia time): staff are at the hotel 24 hours a day, the room is held all night, you can leave luggage when you check out, and you check in directly at the front desk. The reply does not mention the phone rule in the booking notes (anyone arriving after midnight must contact the property by phone at least a day ahead), but it answers your message, so a call to +86-21-63736888 by 22 Nov is a safe extra, not a must. For the record: on 5 Nov the booking's special request was changed to a 06:00 arrival (Trip.com shows it passed on to the property at 22:04) and the same message went into the Trip.com chat in English and Chinese. The night of 23 Nov is already paid.

Check

Be back in Kota Kinabalu by Mon 23 Nov

Renee's email of 7 Oct has you flying to Singapore on 13 Nov, then to KL on 15 Nov, with a Singapore event on 18 Nov and a return possibly around 19 Nov (Scoot ref A5DJHY). The leg home to Kota Kinabalu is not in the emails read, so I could not confirm it lands before 22:30 on the 23rd.

Missing

No purpose, meetings or contacts found

Nothing in Gmail, the Adelphi mailbox or either calendar says who you are seeing or why. A WhatsApp group called "Shanghai 25th Nov – 1st Dec" (Johannes Lo) was behind the hotel choice, but WhatsApp was not read. roy@inco.com.my was not signed in on the Chrome I could reach.

Weather in Shanghai, 24 Nov – 1 Dec

Cool, dry late autumn, a little milder than normal. Mornings 8 to 11 °C (about 12 °C at the 03:00 landing), afternoons 15 to 20 °C, about 0.7 rainy days of the 8, likeliest Tue 24 Nov (22%). Dry from 25 to 29 Nov. Pack layers and a light coat; the umbrella is a small precaution. This is 6 to 13 days ahead, so confidence is low to moderate: read it as what to expect and how to pack, not a day plan.

Updated Wed 18 Nov. This replaces the 15 Nov numbers, which were wetter: Tue 24 Nov rain was 44% (now 22%) and Wed 25 Nov 19% (now 1%).

Landing, 03:00 on Tue 24 Nov: about 12 °C (7 to 14). Roughly a 1 in 7 chance of some rain in that hour (14%). A fog delay is unlikely, but a hazy landing is common: at Pudong, between 02:00 and 08:00 on 21 to 27 Nov over the last 20 years, visibility fell under 1 km on 5% of nights (7 of 140).

Cold nights: the models still disagree most about night lows (for Thu 26 Nov the ensemble medians run from 6 °C to 13 °C). Plan for 1 to 14 °C mornings; a cold night near 1 to 5 °C cannot be ruled out on any day.

Dry from 25 to 29 Nov: 0 to 5% a day in the ensembles (1, 0, 0, 2 and 5%), against 23 to 26% normal for those dates; Mon 30 Nov is 13% against 25% normal. Tue 1 Dec is 23%, 1 percentage point above Tue 24 Nov, but its trust label is very low (13 days out, 4 ensembles).

Milder than normal from Thu 26 to Sat 28 Nov: highs of 18 to 20 °C against about 15 °C normal. Tue 24 Nov is the opposite: a high near 15 °C against 16 °C normal. At 8 to 10 days this is still a lean, not a promise.

Day by day: the middle value and the likely range (the 10% to 90% range across all ensemble members). Low is the lowest temperature of that calendar day (often late evening). Rain is the chance of at least 1 mm that day.

  1. Tue 24 Novyou land at 03:00
    Low 10, high 15 °C, rain 22%

    Likely range: low 3 to 12, high 12 to 17. Trust: moderate (6 days out, 5 ensembles).

  2. Wed 25 Nov
    Low 8, high 16 °C, rain 1%

    Likely range: low 1 to 12, high 12 to 20. Trust: moderate (7 days out, 5 ensembles).

  3. Thu 26 Nov
    Low 10, high 18 °C, rain 0%

    Likely range: low 5 to 13, high 14 to 21. Trust: low to moderate (8 days out, 5 ensembles).

  4. Fri 27 Nov
    Low 10, high 20 °C, rain 0%

    Likely range: low 6 to 14, high 16 to 22. Trust: low to moderate (9 days out, 5 ensembles).

  5. Sat 28 Nov
    Low 9, high 18 °C, rain 2%

    Likely range: low 6 to 13, high 15 to 21. Trust: low (4 ensembles).

  6. Sun 29 Nov
    Low 9, high 17 °C, rain 5%

    Likely range: low 4 to 13, high 14 to 21. Trust: low (4 ensembles).

  7. Mon 30 Nov
    Low 11, high 18 °C, rain 13%

    Likely range: low 5 to 14, high 14 to 22. Trust: low (4 ensembles).

  8. Tue 1 Decflight 19:55
    Low 12, high 18 °C, rain 23%

    Likely range: low 5 to 15, high 15 to 22. Trust: very low (13 days out, 4 ensembles).

What to pack: layers (a sweater plus a light down or wool coat) and a scarf for the mornings and late evenings. A compact umbrella is a small precaution: no day before Mon 30 Nov is above 22%. If nights near freezing worry you, bring a warmer coat or thermal layer. Indoor heating in hotels and malls is usually on.

Check again: this is Sandy's second look, after the one dated 15 Nov. The next re-check is Sun 22 Nov, the day before you fly, when the whole first half of the trip is inside 7 days; ask for this card to be refreshed after it. Once you are there, Sandy follows your phone and shows Shanghai. The China Meteorological Administration's Shanghai page (weather.cma.cn) shows 7 days.

Source: Sandy's Shanghai outlook, update written Wed 18 Nov 2026 (data pulled 09:35 Malaysia time): nine global models and five ensembles at the hotel's coordinates, 20 years of ERA5 records and of the Pudong and Hongqiao airport thermometers, and a check against the last 48 hours of airport reports. The airport thermometers are 10 to 25 km from the hotel, and the city centre can run a little warmer at night. No Chinese official forecast was used. Not reviewed by a second reviewer.

How these were chosen

Of the 36 Chinese restaurants, 35 come from Dianping’s 2026 Must-Eat List, within about 10 km of the centre. Each of those 35 has an independent second source and ratings on Dianping and Amap; 35 are saved on both apps. Ratings read between 11 and 14 Nov 2026.

The House of Rong was added from the Michelin Guide at the owner’s request; its Dianping rating was read on 14 Nov 2026, and its Amap rating was read on 13 Nov 2026.

New dining picks: picked for overall quality from Michelin, Gambero Rosso and named food writers (2024 to 2026). Dianping and Amap ratings and open status are added as each place is checked in the apps; until then, check the hours and book ahead.

Nightlife picks: picked for overall quality from named, dated reviews and lists (2024 to 2026). Where a dated event or a recent review was found it shows as “Evidence it is open”; where none shows, confirm the venue is trading before you go. These are music-led clubs and live venues; bottle-service clubs were reviewed and left out. Venues open, close and move often: check the venue’s own WeChat or Instagram for the night you plan.

Bring your passport: clubs may ask for ID. Have WeChat Pay or Alipay ready, and check the bill. The metro stops around 22:30 to 23:30; for a late ride home use Didi or an official taxi, not touts outside clubs.

App records last updated 14 Nov 2026, 17:30.

No venue photos are shown for now. Only pictures of the venue itself (from its own channels, Dianping or another verified source, each credited) will be added, as many as can be verified.

How to read the second source. Michelin is listed in the Michelin Guide Shanghai (9 picks). Press / writer is original reporting or a first-hand visit by a named reporter or an established food writer (10). Crowd rating is 4.3 or more from at least 100 reviews on Trip.com or Ctrip for the same branch (4). Amap rating is 4.3 or more from at least 100 Amap reviews on the exact branch, a second source outside Meituan, approved by the reviewer (9). Two diners is two separate people's meal write-ups on different sites, the weakest of the four (4).

Dianping, Meituan and the Black Pearl guide share one owner, so none of them counts as a second source. Reviews are Dianping's own counts (Amap's are shown separately). Spend is the Dianping average per person for the 35 Dianping-list picks; added picks state their own price source. "From centre" is Dianping's distance to the city centre, not to your hotel. Links open the source in a new tab; most are in Chinese. "No closure found" is not proof a place is open today, so check the hours.

Chinese restaurant sources. The 35 Dianping-list picks come from Dianping’s 2026 Must-Eat List, with each shop page’s rating, review count and hours as recorded in the supplied app checks. Their Amap ratings are read from Amap's own detail pages. Second sources are linked in each row. The House of Rong was added from the Michelin Guide at the owner’s request; its Dianping rating was read on 14 Nov 2026, and its Amap rating was read on 13 Nov 2026. Full spreadsheet and review records for the Dianping-list picks: Restaurants folder in Dropbox.
